title: गोपालपसाद रिमाल, ‘मसान’ नाटक र नारीवाद [Gopalpasad Rimal, 'Masan' Drama and Feminism]
nepali: साहित्य समाजको दर्पण हो । समाजमा देखिएका विकृति, विसङ्गति, अन्याय, अत्याचार, दमन, शोषण,उत्पीडन आदिको यथार्थ पर्दाफास गराई समाजलाई प्रगतितर्फ उन्मुख गर्ने काम साहित्यले गर्दछ । साहित्यका प्रमुख विधा श्रव्यविधा र दृश्यविधा हुन । श्रव्यविधा अर्थात सुनेर र पढेर आनन्द लिनेवधाअन्तर्गत कथा, कविता, निबन्ध, उपन्यास आदि पर्दछन भने दृश्यविधाअन्तर्गत नाटक पर्दछ ।दृश्यविधाभित्र पर्ने नाटक मञ्चनयोग्य हुनुपर्छ र दर्शकले रङ्गमञ्चबाट प्रदर्शित वा मञ्चित नाटककोवषयवस्तुलाई पात्रहरूका अभिनयद्वारा बुझने प्रयास गर्दछन । आधुनिक नेपाली नाटकको लगभगशुभारम्भदेखि नै सामाजिक यथार्थवादी प्रवृत्तिलाई आधारभूमि मान्दै आफनो नाटयलेखन परम्परालाईनरन्तरता दिन सफल नाटककार व्यक्तित्वको नाम गोपालप्रसाद रिमाल हो । आधुनिक नेपाली साहित्यकोफाँटमा थोरै लेखेर प्रशस्त ख्याति कमाउन सफल रिमालले ‘आमाको सपना’ नामक कविता सङग्र्रहका साथैमसान’ र ‘यो प्रेम’ नाटक अनि ‘माया’ नामक एकाङ्कीको मात्र संरचना तथा प्रकाशन गरेका छन ।तत्कालीन नेपाली समाजमा विद्यमान सामाजिक जीवनका यथार्थ पक्षहरूलाई आत्मसात गर्न सफल रिमालसाँच्चैँ सामाजिक यथार्थवादी नाटककार हुन । नेपाली कविताको क्षेत्रमा नवीन गद्यशैलीका शुभारम्भकर्ताकवि व्यक्तित्व रिमालको खारिएको र माझिएको विधा चाहिँ नाटक नै हो ।
american_english: Literature is a mirror of society. By exposing the reality of social anomalies, incongruities, injustices, atrocities, oppression, exploitation, and persecution, literature serves to orient society toward progress. The principal genres of literature are the audio genre and the visual genre. While the audio genre—meaning the genre enjoyed by listening and reading—includes stories, poetry, essays, novels, and so forth, drama falls under the visual genre. Drama belonging to the visual genre must be stageable, and audiences strive to understand the subject matter of the drama staged or performed in the theater through the actors' performances. The name of the playwright figure who succeeded in giving continuity to his dramatic writing tradition by taking the social-realist trend as his foundation virtually from the inception of modern Nepali drama is Gopal Prasad Rimal. Having achieved widespread fame while writing little in the field of modern Nepali literature, Rimal composed and published only the poetry collection titled 'Aamako Sapana', along with the plays 'Masan' and 'Yo Prem', and the one-act play titled 'Maya'. Rimal, who succeeded in internalizing the realistic aspects of social life existing in contemporary Nepali society, is truly a social-realist playwright. In the field of Nepali poetry, for the poet figure Rimal, who pioneered a novel prose style, the refined and polished genre is indeed drama.

The main genres of literature are the audio genre and the visual genre. While the audio genre—meaning the stuff you enjoy by listening and reading—covers stories, poetry, essays, novels, and all that, drama falls under the visual genre. Rimal, who really captured the real aspects of social life in the Nepali society back then, is truly a social-realist playwright.
